tweets.text:
Since then, VAWA has been reauthorized four times.
 
And each time, President Biden worked across the aisle to strengthen it.
 
In 2000 – to expand the law’s protections to better support survivors of dating violence, stalking, and sexual assault.
 
In 2005 – to expand access to services for immigrants and communities of color.
 
In 2013 – to expand protections for Tribal lands and ensure access for everyone, regardless of sexual orientation and gender identity.
 
And in 2022 – to expand protections against online harassment and abuse and secure the highest-ever funding levels to implement VAWA.
